lessons.correction: Focus on increasing production and technology while maintaining a safe economy. Scout to clarify the opponent's intentions.
lessons.mistake: Assuming the enemy's build without scouting and neglecting defense while teching.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or if you face early pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid blind teching without scouting
lessons.when: Early game around 180 seconds, when you have heavy economy and technology investment but unknown enemy composition, with possible Reapers and Marines.
lessons.why: Early game is about establishing a strong foundation. Heavy technology investment can pay off later, but you need to be aware of potential early pressure.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army while maintaining air support from Void Rays. Increase production and technology, and consider adding more air units if the opponent lacks anti-air.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting ground defense and failing to exploit your air advantage.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent adapts with anti-air or if you need to adjust your composition.
lessons.title: Leverage Void Rays against ground-heavy enemy
lessons.when: Late midgame around 600 seconds, when you have a ground-oriented army with Void Rays and the opponent shows a ground posture with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Hellions.
lessons.why: The opponent's ground army is strong, but your Void Rays provide an advantage if they lack anti-air. You can leverage this to gain map control.

lessons.correction: Focus on increasing production and technology while maintaining a safe economy. Scout to confirm the opponent's build.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to defense at the expense of economy and neglecting scouting for tech switches or all-ins.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or if you face early pressure.
lessons.title: Prepare for bio-based army while expanding
lessons.when: Early game around 180 seconds, when you have an unknown army composition, heavy economy, and are expanding, while the opponent shows a ground posture with Marines and Marauders.
lessons.why: The opponent's ground posture with Marines and Marauders suggests a bio-based army. You need to prepare for that with appropriate units and upgrades.
